name: Landhaus Langmaier
beschreibung: Landhaus Langmaier welcomes holidaymakers to a sunny and idyllic location in the village of Thiersee in the Kufstein district. This traditional alpine guesthouse is celebrated for its attentive hospitality and peaceful atmosphere. Tastefully appointed rooms and self-catering apartments feature warm wooden furnishings and scenic balconies with uninterrupted views of the Kaisergebirge. A manicured garden lawn provides peaceful relaxation after mountain excursions. In summer, Lake Thiersee offers swimming and boating alongside valley trails, while winter brings tobogganing and scenic cross-country ski paths.
kurzbeschreibung: Charming family holiday home in Thiersee in the Kufstein district overlooking the Kaisergebirge.
